title: Sources: China says it will not approve requests from Chinese companies registered overseas after 2023 to list outside mainland China, impacting tech startups
html:

summary: Reuters : Sources: China says it will not approve requests from Chinese companies registered overseas after 2023 to list outside mainland China, impacting tech startups — China's securities watchdog has told some law firms it will not approve plans by red-chip firms to list outside mainland China …
